definition: Spastic ataxia 11, autosomal dominant (SPAX11; OMIM #621226) is a progressive neurological disorder caused by monoallelic (de novo or inherited) pathogenic variants in the TUBA4A gene, characterized primarily by progressive cerebellar ataxia and spasticity.
